root_cause: The palette extractor read `font-family: var(--ff-label)` literally and quoted `var(--ff-label)` as a font name, producing invalid CSS in the generated palette and a broken font stack in the browser.

details.rule: When parsing CSS values, resolve var() references against the custom-property table first. If a reference cannot be resolved, skip it rather than emitting it as a value. Never treat an unresolved var() as a concrete token.
